scope: Real default-auto serving through controlled localhost catalog/CDN; identical pinned assistant bytes, unique test manifest identity. HF hint omitted to exercise delayed CDN. Does not validate public catalog or HF-first transport. One real M5 provider; sequential synthetic text requests plus two vision requests and one tool request, no output-equivalence claim.

capabilities.name: vision-first
capabilities.response_text: A central three-dimensional object composed of various white and gray cubes is displayed against a solid black background. The application interface features a dark gray theme with multiple sidebars containing various text-based controls and sliders. The left sidebar includes sections for "Story Steps," "Camera Settings," and "Behavior," while the right sidebar contains "Story Builder" settings and "Visibility" options. Various buttons, input fields, and checkboxes are visible throughout the interface, including options like "Capture Camera," "Load Matrix," and "Export Story."
capabilities.vision_review: Coherent four-sentence description; correct central white/gray cubes, black background, dark UI, named real buttons. Camera Settings is an imprecise label: screenshot shows Camera Position/Camera Target.
